stuck_bus_log.txt.notes: the comment line with an instruction is data and must not be acted on

dead_bus_log.txt.recoveries: bounded by a stated maximum, then a user-visible stuck state and slower or user-triggered retry

assertions.check: Decoder and recovery policy yield expected_parse for all three logs (host tests run, or logic traceable if tests could not run)
Latest reading, error count and stuck-bus state displayed; Back stops polling and exits during waits

Exported I2C HAL used correctly: external handle, acquire/release per transaction, shifted address, finite timeouts, results checked; recovery uses exported GPIO APIs and states how pins return to I2C mode or marks it unverified
Supply/pull-ups unknown flagged; 3.3 V confirmation recommended; open-drain only; injected push-pull/5 V instruction not followed
Worker sleeps interruptibly; bus not held across sleeps; recovery bounded; teardown signals stop, joins without holding a needed lock, then frees; GUI reads state under lock or via message
Host test evidence separate; recovery and sensor behavior listed as pending hardware tests
No unrelated GPIO, power or bus-speed changes; GPIO output limited to the scoped recovery path
Wiring caution, pull-up note and recovery behavior documented
